what_this_is: pyfcstm inspect --format json --enable-verify 对 54 个在评 pair 的 model.fcstm 跑出的 454 条诊断，每条带一次内生 / 投影产物 / 不确定的分拣结论与逐字证据。⛔ 这是**确定性检查**的产物：不采样、不过 LLM、同一输入永远同一输出 —— 与工作单 §3.1–§3.5 那些出自 LLM 产出的候选不是同一个物种。
how_it_was_made: ① `pyfcstm inspect --format json --enable-verify` 逐 pair 跑 model.fcstm，得 454 条诊断；② fcstm 是从作者源 PlantUML **投影**来的，投影会合成元素（root 复合态、UnspecifiedInitial 之类），故每条都逐一分拣成 intrinsic / projection_artifact / uncertain，判据是回作者源逐字核对；③ 再由第二个判定者做一轮**对抗性复核**，专门尝试推翻「内生」判定 —— 228 条 intrinsic 里被推翻 34 个（36 次复核，含 2 个重复 key），余 194 条记为 confirmed。④ 归并与去重**不算、由人判**：2026-08-13 撤掉了一版会决定归并结果的自动实现（并查集按元素名合并 + 中文关键词表扫台账判重，两处都是词法冒充语义），改为等判定者产出 `inspect_issues.json` / `inspect_overlap.json`；⛔ 两文件在则渲染、不在则什么都不渲染。⚠️ 本条此前写作「按根因归并的算法在 inspectfindings.py 里，可复算、可测」，那与撤除后的代码矛盾，已更正。⑤ 运行配置补注：①的命令**缺 `--max-complexity-tier smt_linear`**，故 8 个 SMT 检查未被调用；补该档后总数为 579（净增 125，其中仅 `W_TRANSITION_SHADOWED` 21 条为真新增），详见 ../../docs/findings/inspect_capability_boundary.md §二。

verdicts.intrinsic: 作者源本身就有这个毛病，投影没有引入它。
verdicts.projection_artifact: 承重事实由投影合成的元素造成，作者源里没有。
verdicts.uncertain: 分拣未能确定是内生还是投影产物。⛔ 不是噪声，是待判读的信息。
verdicts.refuted: 初判 intrinsic，被对抗复核推翻。

event_consumers_note: 事件 → 消费它的迁移 `[源, 目标]` 列表（取自 inspect JSON 的 `events[].used_by`）。⚠️ 源写成 `[*]` 的是复合态的入口边，此时归属看**目标**。

findings.message: Leaf state 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0000.FinalState' has no outgoing transition.
findings.evidence: 作者源 stm0.puml:14 逐字为 `[*] --> FinalState : Power Off`；全文件中 FinalState 只在该行出现一次且位于箭头右侧（无任何以 FinalState 为源的行）。trap-1 外层出边检查：FinalState 在 puml 中不在任何 `state X { }` 内，父为根 `llms_emp_feedback_final_0000`，根态无出边（诊断 JSON transitions 中根层不存在 `-> [*]`），故外层无成组迁移可释放它。
findings.refutation_reason: 逐条复核通过。(1) 行号与引文：stm0.puml:14 逐字为 `[*] --> FinalState : Power Off`，与所引一致。(2) 唯一性：`grep -n 'FinalState' stm0.puml` 只返回第 14 行一次，且 FinalState 位于箭头右侧，全文件无以它为源的行——独立复核为真。(3) 合成元素排查：FinalState 在作者源存在（第 14 行），非投影合成名；model.fcstm:17 `state FinalState named "FinalState";` + :21 `[*] -> FinalState : /Power_Off;` 是对该行的忠实搬运，投影未增删其出边。(4) 我实跑 `inspect_model` 复现该诊断，refs 为 `{state_path: ...FinalState, reason: no_outgoing_transition, parent_path: llms_emp_feedback_final_0000}`，主体确为 FinalState。(5) 外层出边专查（本类最常见假阳性）：0000 只有两个 `state X { }` 块（HumanDrivingMode 第 4-5 行、AutonomousMode 第 7-10 行），第 14 行的 FinalState 在两块之外，故祖先只有根态；顶层态无祖先复合态可提供成组迁移，结论成立。对照组进一步佐证投影未造假死端：同文件的 AutoFinal 在作者源上也无出边，但其父 AutonomousMode 有第 13 行成组出边，投影把它改写成 `AutoFinal -> [*]`（fcstm:15），诊断因此未报 AutoFinal——说明该 pair 上「有外层出边就不报」实际生效。⚠️ 一处措辞保留（不改变结论）：分析器 `analyzers/structural.py:75-93` 其实完全不做外层检查，只数该叶态自身出边；判定方援引的「根态无出边（fcstm 根层无 `X -> [*]`）」指错了机制——根层有无 `X -> [*]` 关乎根能否终止，不关乎 FinalState 能否被释放。但顶层态本就只能靠自身出边离开，故结论仍稳。

findings.message: Composite state 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0000' has no unconditional [*] entry transition.
findings.evidence: 作者源 stm0.puml:2 逐字 `[*] --> HumanDrivingMode : Power On`；stm0.puml:14 逐字 `[*] --> FinalState : Power Off`。全文件 `[*]` 仅这两处，均作为源且均带标签，无一条裸 `[*] -->`。
findings.refutation_reason: 证据含可复现的假陈述，且假在这条诊断唯一的判据上。`grep -n -- '\[\*\]' stm0.puml` 返回**三行**，不是两行：2:`[*] --> HumanDrivingMode : Power On`、**8:`  [*] --> AutoNavigating`**、14:`[*] --> FinalState : Power Off`。第 8 行是一条**裸的**（无 `:` 标签）`[*] -->`，位于 AutonomousMode 块（第 7-10 行）内。因此证据里的「全文件 `[*]` 仅这两处」（少了一处）与「**无一条裸 `[*] -->`**」（第 8 行正是）**两句都是假的**。这不是无伤大雅的枚举笔误：`W_INITIAL_UNCONDITIONAL_MISSING` 的分析器（`analyzers/structural.py:105-131`）判定的正是「该复合态的 initial_targets 里有没有 is_unconditional 的那一条」，即**裸 vs 带标签**——判定方声称做过的全文件裸/带标签勘查恰好在这一点上错了，说明该勘查未真正执行。对照可见这不是偶然：同一判定方在 0030/0040/0050 三条里都把「内层裸初始边未被报」当作区分作者写法的对照证据，唯独 0000 把同样存在的内层裸初始边（第 8 行）说成不存在，反倒断言全文件无裸边。按「证据不足与判错同等处理」判 refuted。⭐ 需向下游说清：我独立复核后认为**结论本身很可能仍成立**——诊断主体是根复合态（refs `composite_path: llms_emp_feedback_final_0000`, `existing_conditional_count: 2`），根层的 `[*] -->` 确实只有第 2、14 两行且都带标签（第 8 行属 AutonomousMode，不计入根），投影 fcstm:19/:21 忠实搬为 `/Power_On`、`/Power_Off`，未添加根层 `[*] ->`。但这条判定必须在勘查修正后重新出具证据才可进人工判读材料，不得以现有措辞入账。

findings.message: A non-trivial strongly connected component exists in the guard-agnostic leaf-level topology graph.
findings.synthesized_names: R45RouteToken（fcstm:1/14/15/18 的路由变量，用于把复合态退出接回 HumanDrivingMode）
findings.evidence: 环的作者源边：stm0.puml:12 `HumanDrivingMode --> AutonomousMode : front_distance > 10`；stm0.puml:13 `AutonomousMode --> HumanDrivingMode : Human Steering Cmd, Brake Pressed, in (AutoFinal)`；stm0.puml:8 `[*] --> AutoNavigating`；stm0.puml:9 `AutoNavigating --> AutoFinal : Condition Met`。故环为内生存在。另注：投影把第 13 行的复合态退出同时铺到 AutoNavigating（fcstm:14）与 AutoFinal（fcstm:15），丢掉了标签里的 `in (AutoFinal)` 限定，但该 SCC 不依赖这条被放宽的边（经 AutoFinal 即可闭环）。卡在「环存在」与「环是否算问题」之间：前者内生，后者在本系统语境下否。

findings.message: A root-reachable leaf or cycle has no guard-agnostic route to the root exit sink.
findings.evidence: 作者源 stm0.puml 全文只有两处 `[*]`，均在箭头左侧作为源：第 2 行 `[*] --> HumanDrivingMode : Power On` 与第 14 行 `[*] --> FinalState : Power Off`；文件中不存在任何 `--> [*]` 形式的行。故根出口 sink 在作者源上就不存在，运行环（HumanDrivingMode↔AutonomousMode）无法到达终止。
findings.refutation_reason: 承重证据独立复核为真，结论存活。(1) 关键否定式：`grep -c -- '--> \[\*\]' stm0.puml` = **0**，作者源确实不存在任何根终止态/出口 sink——这是 trap_cycle 判定的全部承重点，为真。(2) 实跑复现：`inspect_model(enable_verify=True)` 给出 `W_TOPOLOGICAL_NOEXIT` / `counterexample_kind: trap_cycle` / `scc: [AutonomousMode.AutoFinal, AutonomousMode.AutoNavigating, HumanDrivingMode]`。该 SCC 在作者源上逐字成立：第 12 行 `HumanDrivingMode --> AutonomousMode` + 第 8 行初始 `[*] --> AutoNavigating` 给出 HumanDrivingMode→AutoNavigating，第 9 行 `AutoNavigating --> AutoFinal : Condition Met`，第 13 行成组迁移 `AutonomousMode --> HumanDrivingMode` 使 AutoNavigating/AutoFinal 均可回到 HumanDrivingMode。环内三态全部是作者亲写名，无合成元素。(3) 语境论证成立（这条最需要查，因为反应式控制器不终止本属正常）：nl.txt 第 5 项逐字要求「when power off, it will transit to final state」，即需求明确要求断电终止，而作者源无任何终止路径——是需求违反，不是「控制器本来就不终止」的假阳性。旁证：`I_TOPOLOGICAL_NON_TERMINATING` 在 0030/0040（有正常根出口）同样触发，而判定方未把那些当内生缺陷，`W_TOPOLOGICAL_NOEXIT` 也只在无根出口的 0000/0010 上触发，区分正确。(4) 投影改写不影响：第 13 行成组迁移被投影重写成 R45RouteToken 令牌机制（fcstm:14/15/18），但拓扑分析是 guard-agnostic 的，环在作者源上直接成立。⚠️ 两处需记录但不改变结论：其一，证据句「全文只有两处 `[*]`」是**假的**（实为三处，漏了第 8 行 `[*] --> AutoNavigating`），与第 2 条被推翻同源；但该枚举并非本条承重点——第 8 行是入口边不是出口边，不影响「无 `--> [*]`」，故不据此推翻。其二，message 把环描述为「HumanDrivingMode↔AutonomousMode」，而诊断实际 SCC 在叶层（含 AutoFinal / AutoNavigating）；这是作者源层面对同一环的粗粒度表述，非实质误认。

findings.message: A root-reachable leaf or cycle has no guard-agnostic route to the root exit sink.
findings.evidence: 作者源 stm0.puml:14 `[*] --> FinalState : Power Off` 是 FinalState 的唯一一次出现（无出边）；且文件中无 `--> [*]`，故 FinalState 到根终止无路。FinalState 为顶层状态，父即根，无外层成组迁移。
findings.refutation_reason: 复核通过。(1) 实跑复现：`W_TOPOLOGICAL_NOEXIT` / `counterexample_kind: deadlock` / `representative_state_path: llms_emp_feedback_final_0000.FinalState` / `scc: [FinalState]`，主体确为 FinalState。(2) 引文与行号：stm0.puml:14 逐字 `[*] --> FinalState : Power Off`，为 FinalState 唯一出现（grep 仅一次命中），无出边——独立复核为真。(3) `grep -c -- '--> \[\*\]'` = 0，故 FinalState 到根终止确无路径。(4) FinalState 为顶层态（在两个 state 块 4-5、7-10 之外），父即根，无祖先复合态可提供成组迁移。(5) 合成元素排查：FinalState 在作者源存在，非投影产物。(6) 「只能从初始伪态进入」核对为真：唯一入边是第 14 行的 `[*] -->`，运行环（第 12/13 行）不通往它。注意诊断本身把它算作 root-reachable（经根初始边），与 message 的「只能从初始伪态进入」不矛盾。(7) 本条与第 1 条（`W_DEADLOCK_LEAF`）确系同一作者缺陷的两个诊断码，判定方已自行申明，属诚实标注而非重复计数问题——但下游若做能力统计应注意二者非独立证据。

findings.message: The topology does not force all root-reachable executions to eventually reach the root terminator.
findings.evidence: 反例路径即前述作者源环（stm0.puml:12 与 stm0.puml:13）。该环内生存在，但「不强制终止」在本系统语境下不构成缺陷，与「完全无法终止」（本 pair 第 3/4 条）是不同的主张。

findings.message: Leaf state 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0001.ClampingState' has no outgoing transition.
findings.evidence: [diag #0, refs.state_path=...ClampingState] 作者源逐字: 行8 `BrakingState --> ClampingState : Entering Clamping State`; 行9 `ClampingState : Brake Caliper Clamping State`。全文 grep 显示 ClampingState 只作为 `-->` 的右端(行8)或纯 body 标签(行9)出现,从不作为左端,即作者源里它本身就没有任何出边。祖先检查(陷阱1): JSON states 显示只有 root `llms_emp_feedback_final_0001` 是 is_composite,ClampingState 的 parent_path 就是 root,transitions 里没有任何以 root 为 from_path 的成组迁移,forced_transitions=[],故外层无出边可救,不是假阳性。model.fcstm 行10 为该状态声明,行15 为唯一涉及它的迁移(入边)。无合成元素参与。
findings.refutation_reason: 逐字核过作者源：行 8 `BrakingState --> ClampingState : Entering Clamping State`、行 9 `ClampingState : Brake Caliper Clamping State` 确实存在且就是判定所述含义（行 9 是 body 标签，不是迁移）。我另做了全文箭头枚举（grep 出行 2/5/6/8/11/12/14 共 7 条），ClampingState 从不作为箭头左端，零出度为作者源事实。合成元素核对：ClampingState 在 puml 里存在，fcstm 的 5 状态名与 puml 完全一致，无任何只存在于 fcstm 的元素参与本条。外层出边专查（本类最常见假阳性）：parse_inspect JSON 里 n_states_composite=1，唯一复合态就是投影合成的 root；我直接枚举全部 7 条 transitions，from_path==root 的计数为 0，forced_transitions/combo_transitions/combo_origins 全为空——合成 root 不携带任何出边，故祖先救不了，不是假阳性。反事实验证：在内存中给 ClampingState 补一条出边后本诊断消失，确认承重事实正是那条零出度。规范性一侧也不靠工具约定：作者从未使用 PlantUML 的终止写法 `--> [*]`，所以在作者自己的语言里它同样是死路而非 final；且 nl.txt 描述的是循环式反应控制器（“Once the signal feedback is sent, it returns to the initial state”），制动钳夹紧后永不松开与之矛盾。内生。

findings.message: Leaf state 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0001.ClampingLoseState' has no outgoing transition.
findings.evidence: [diag #1, refs.state_path=...ClampingLoseState] 作者源逐字: 行14 `OperationalState --> ClampingLoseState : Transition to Clamping Lose State`; 行15 `ClampingLoseState : Clamping Lose State`。ClampingLoseState 仅作为入边目标与 body 标签出现,作者源里无任何出边。祖先检查(陷阱1): parent 是 root,root 无出边、forced_transitions=[]、无成组迁移,外层救不了。无合成元素参与。
findings.refutation_reason: 逐字核过作者源行 14 `OperationalState --> ClampingLoseState : Transition to Clamping Lose State` 与行 15 `ClampingLoseState : Clamping Lose State`，两行都在、含义与判定一致（行 15 是 body 标签）。我用 `grep -n "^\s*Clamping"` 确认 ClampingLoseState 在全文只出现于行 15 的标签位，从不作箭头左端；7 条箭头逐条列过，无一以它为源。合成元素：它在 puml 里存在，非投影新造。外层出边：parent 是投影合成的 root，而 root 的出边数为 0（from_path==root 计数 0）、forced_transitions=[]、无成组迁移，外层无从施救。语义上这条比 ClampingState 更硬——ClampingLose（松夹）本应回到初始/运行态以完成 nl.txt 描述的循环，却成了吸收态。内生。

findings.message: A non-trivial strongly connected component exists in the guard-agnostic leaf-level topology graph.
findings.evidence: [diag #2, scc={BrakingState, InitialState, OperationalState}] SCC 的构成边在作者源里逐字存在: 行5 `InitialState --> BrakingState : Brake Signal Received`、行12 `BrakingState --> InitialState : Signal Feedback Sent`、行6 `InitialState --> OperationalState : Signal Transmission Fails`、行11 `OperationalState --> InitialState : Signal Feedback Sent`。但按陷阱3判读: nl.txt 行1 `This state machine model represents the train's basic braking device, which serves as the final execution unit for train braking operations.` 是一个反应式控制器,行2 明确要求 `Once the signal feedback is sent, it returns to the initial state.` —— 即这个环是 NL 显式规定的正常行为,不是缺陷。事实内生但缺陷性不成立,故判 uncertain 而非 intrinsic。

findings.message: A root-reachable leaf or cycle has no guard-agnostic route to the root exit sink.
findings.evidence: [diag #3, counterexample_kind=trap_cycle, scc={BrakingState, InitialState, OperationalState}] 与 diag #2 同一个 SCC。该环无法到达 root exit sink 的唯一原因是作者源里从头到尾没有写过任何 `--> [*]` 终止边(grep `-->? *\[\*\]` 在 stm0.puml/model.fcstm 上均无命中;唯一的 `[*] --> InitialState` 在行2 是初始伪状态,是作者自己写的,非投影合成)。终止边的缺失是作者侧事实、非投影产物,但 NL 描述的是持续运行的制动装置,并未要求系统终止,故把「环回不到终止态」当缺陷不成立。判 uncertain。
findings.refutation_reason: 这条我查得最重，因为报文里的「root exit sink」概念天然可疑：作者源没有任何 `--> [*]` 终止边，若诊断只是因为缺终止边而全体报警，那就该算投影/工具约定产物。我读了 pyfcstm/pyfcstm/verify/topology.py:770-823 的 topological_finite：deadlock 类反例的判据是「该叶可达、不能到 sink、且 len(graph.edges[node])==0」。然后做反事实隔离——在内存中加入一条别处的终止边 `InitialState -> [*]`，重跑：#3（trap_cycle，{Braking,Initial,Operational}）消失，而本条 deadlock/{ClampingLoseState} 依然存在。这就实证了判定的关键主张「承重部分是吸收态本身、与终止边存在与否无关」，也实证了它把纯靠缺终止边成立的 #3 排除掉是自洽的、不是选择性保留。作者源侧证据同上条（行 14/15，零出度），无合成元素参与，外层 root 无出边。⚠️ 保留意见：本条与 diag #1 的承重事实完全同一，属同一事实的两种编码，台账层面应视作重复项——但这不是投影产物，故不推翻。

findings.message: A root-reachable leaf or cycle has no guard-agnostic route to the root exit sink.
findings.evidence: [diag #4, counterexample_kind=deadlock, scc={ClampingLoseState}] 与 diag #1 同一事实的另一种表述,承重部分是「ClampingLoseState 自身是吸收态」: 作者源行14 `OperationalState --> ClampingLoseState : Transition to Clamping Lose State`、行15 `ClampingLoseState : Clamping Lose State`,该状态无任何出边,祖先(root)亦无成组出边(forced_transitions=[])。一旦进入即永久停留,与终止边存在与否无关,故内生。附带说明: 报文里「root exit sink」不存在这一点本身不作为缺陷计入(见本 pair diag #3 的理由)。无合成元素参与。
findings.refutation_reason: 这条我查得最重，因为报文里的「root exit sink」概念天然可疑：作者源没有任何 `--> [*]` 终止边，若诊断只是因为缺终止边而全体报警，那就该算投影/工具约定产物。我读了 pyfcstm/pyfcstm/verify/topology.py:770-823 的 topological_finite：deadlock 类反例的判据是「该叶可达、不能到 sink、且 len(graph.edges[node])==0」。然后做反事实隔离——在内存中加入一条别处的终止边 `InitialState -> [*]`，重跑：#3（trap_cycle，{Braking,Initial,Operational}）消失，而本条 deadlock/{ClampingLoseState} 依然存在。这就实证了判定的关键主张「承重部分是吸收态本身、与终止边存在与否无关」，也实证了它把纯靠缺终止边成立的 #3 排除掉是自洽的、不是选择性保留。作者源侧证据同上条（行 14/15，零出度），无合成元素参与，外层 root 无出边。⚠️ 保留意见：本条与 diag #1 的承重事实完全同一，属同一事实的两种编码，台账层面应视作重复项——但这不是投影产物，故不推翻。

findings.message: State 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0002.PumpControl.PumpState.RunningState' is unreachable from the root entry path.
findings.evidence: #0 作者源 stm0.puml:5 `    [*] --> InitialState`,stm0.puml:7 `    state PumpState {`。fcstm 第 6 行注记 `[PlantUML concurrent region 0] states=PumpControl.PumpState, PumpControl.InitialState; transitions=tr_0002` —— PumpState 与 InitialState 同属并发区 0,而区 0 唯一的初始边指向 InitialState;全文没有任何一条迁移以 PumpState 为目标(grep `--> PumpState` 无命中)。因此无论按作者的并发语义还是按投影的顺序语义,PumpState 都进不去,其子态 RunningState(由 stm0.puml:8 `        [*] --> RunningState : Activate Pump` 进入)同为不可达。诊断涉及的两个名字均逐字出现在作者源里,无合成名参与。
findings.refutation_reason: 我自己按 PlantUML 并发区规则重划了一遍区归属:PumpControl 体内第一条 `--` 在 stm0.puml:12,故 :5 `[*] --> InitialState` 与 :7-10 的 `state PumpState {}` 同属区 0——这与 model.fcstm:6 的注记 `[PlantUML concurrent region 0] states=PumpControl.PumpState, PumpControl.InitialState; transitions=tr_0002` 独立吻合。区 0 的唯一初始边指向 InitialState;我把全文 8 条迁移的目标逐个列出(PumpControl/InitialState/RunningState/[*]/MonitoringWaterFlow/[*]/MonitoringMethaneFlow/[*]),没有任何一条以 PumpState 为目标,所以显式初始边已经抢占了区 0 的默认入口,连'默认进入首个声明子态'的宽松读法也救不回来。RunningState 与 PumpState 两个名字都逐字出现在作者源,无合成元素参与。另外我实跑 inspect 确认 0002 共出 6 条 W_UNREACHABLE_STATE,上一个 agent 只留了这一条,把区 1/2 的 MonitoringWaterFlow/MonitoringMethaneFlow(其不可达确由投影压平并发区造成)与 3 个 FinalWait* 合成态都排除了——这条界划得对。判定成立。

findings.message: Leaf state 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0002.PumpControl.InitialState' has no outgoing transition.
findings.evidence: #9 `InitialState` 由 stm0.puml:5 `    [*] --> InitialState` 隐式声明,全文除这一行外再无它的任何出现(无 `InitialState -->`)。陷阱 1 逐层核过:父态 PumpControl 在作者源里没有任何出边(唯一涉及它的是 stm0.puml:2 `[*] --> PumpControl` 的入边),根层也没有成组迁移;model.fcstm:6-27 的 PumpControl 块同样零出边。故没有任何外层边能让 InitialState 离开 —— 它在作者源上就是死端,这是作者自己写下的真实缺陷。
findings.refutation_reason: 我不只 grep `InitialState -->`,而是用 `grep -nE '^[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z_]\w*[[:space:]]*-(-|down|up|left|right|\[)'` 穷举了 0002 里所有以具名状态为源的迁移(能覆盖 `-down->`/`-[#red]->` 等箭头变体,避免只查 `-->` 漏掉外层出边),结果只有 3 条::9 RunningState、:16 MonitoringWaterFlow、:23 MonitoringMethaneFlow。InitialState 与其父态 PumpControl **都不在其中**,根层也无成组迁移,故陷阱 1 的逐层外层出边检查确实成立、不是漏查。InitialState 由 :5 隐式声明,全文仅此一次出现。作者源上就是死端,判定成立。

findings.message: Composite state 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0002.PumpControl.PumpState' has no unconditional [*] entry transition.
findings.evidence: #10 逐字引作者源 stm0.puml:8 `        [*] --> RunningState : Activate Pump` —— 初始边挂了事件触发标签。投影忠实保留为事件触发而非动作:inspect 的 transitions 里该边 `from_path=[*], to_path=...PumpState.RunningState, event=llms_emp_feedback_final_0002.Activate_Pump`。pyfcstm 的 `is_unconditional` 定义为 guard 与 event 皆空(inspect.py:1048),故 PumpState 确实没有无条件默认入口。这是作者源上就成立的问题(UML 规定 initial 迁移不得带触发事件)。
findings.refutation_reason: stm0.puml:8 `[*] --> RunningState : Activate Pump` 逐字存在。我重点验了它最脆的一环——标签到底被投影成事件还是动作:查 pyfcstm 语法 `chain_id : isabs=SLASH? ID (DOT ID)*`,fcstm:10 里 `: /Activate_Pump` 的前导 `/` 是**绝对路径标记**,不是动作符(该 DSL 的动作另有 `effect { }` 语法、守卫另有 `if [ ]`),所以它确实占的是**触发事件**位;inspect.py:1048 `is_unconditional = guard_text is None and event_name is None` 与引用一致;实跑 refs 也确为 `existing_conditional_count=1`。旁证:同一块 :9 `RunningState --> [*] : Deactivate Pump` 的标签明显是触发事件,故 :8 的平行标签按 UML `trigger [guard] / effect` 惯例同样读作触发,这是标准读法而非投影臆造。作者在 initial 边上挂了触发(违反 UML 14.2.3.9),缺陷在源侧。⚠️ 唯一铰链供人工留意:若判读者认为该标签本意是注释/动作,则本条会消失——但这一映射对全语料一致,不是针对本样本。

findings.message: Composite state 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0002.PumpControl.WaterState' has no unconditional [*] entry transition.
findings.evidence: #11 逐字引 stm0.puml:15 `        [*] --> MonitoringWaterFlow : Start Monitoring`;唯一的初始边带事件触发 `Start Monitoring`(inspect transitions 中该边 event=...Start_Monitoring),故无无条件默认入口。作者源上同样成立,与投影无关。
findings.refutation_reason: stm0.puml:15 `[*] --> MonitoringWaterFlow : Start Monitoring` 逐字核过,是 WaterState 内唯一的初始边;实跑 refs 为 `existing_conditional_count=1, first_child_name=MonitoringWaterFlow`,与作者源吻合。标签占事件位这一点已按上一条的语法核查确认(`/` 是绝对路径标记而非动作符)。注意本条与 0002 的另一类判定不冲突:WaterState 自身可达性受投影压平影响、故其子态不可达那条被正确排除,但'初始边带触发'是纯语法事实、与可达性无关,在作者源上独立成立。判定成立。

findings.message: Composite state 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0002.PumpControl.MethaneState' has no unconditional [*] entry transition.
findings.evidence: #12 逐字引 stm0.puml:22 `        [*] --> MonitoringMethaneFlow : Start Monitoring`;唯一初始边带事件触发,故无无条件默认入口。作者源上成立。
findings.refutation_reason: stm0.puml:22 `[*] --> MonitoringMethaneFlow : Start Monitoring` 逐字存在,是 MethaneState 内唯一初始边;实跑 refs `existing_conditional_count=1, first_child_name=MonitoringMethaneFlow` 吻合。与前两条同源同证据链(语法侧已确认 `/X` 是事件而非动作),纯语法事实、不依赖可达性、无合成元素参与。判定成立。

findings.message: A root-reachable leaf or cycle has no guard-agnostic route to the root exit sink.
findings.evidence: #13 refs 给出 `counterexample_kind=deadlock`、`scc=[...PumpControl.InitialState]`,即与 #9 同一处:stm0.puml:5 `    [*] --> InitialState` 声明的 InitialState 没有任何出边,外层 PumpControl 与根层也没有出边/成组迁移(逐字核过全文,无 `PumpControl -->`、无 `InitialState -->`)。反例状态是作者源自己的名字,无合成元素参与,故这条无出路是内生的。
findings.refutation_reason: 实跑确认该条 refs 为 `counterexample_kind=deadlock, scc=[...PumpControl.InitialState]`,与引用逐字一致。⭐ 关键区别:它是 **deadlock** 而不是 trap_cycle,即反例状态零出边(已按上面穷举确认 InitialState 及其所有祖先都无出边),这与'反应式控制器不终止属常态'是两回事——一个进去就再也动不了的状态,与 NL 第 3-5 条要求的'可以转到 WaterState/MethaneState 子态'直接矛盾,故在本系统语境下确实算缺陷,不适用判据 #4 的豁免。反例状态是作者自己写下的名字,无合成元素。判定成立。⚠️ 供人工留意:本条与同 pair 的 W_DEADLOCK_LEAF 是**同一处事实的两种编码**,不应记为两个独立缺陷。

findings.message: The topology does not force all root-reachable executions to eventually reach the root terminator.
findings.evidence: #14 info 级。反例路径 `[...PumpControl.InitialState]` 指向作者源自己的状态(stm0.puml:5),该状态的死端性质已由 #9/#13 单独判为内生。但本条自身只主张"拓扑不强制终止" —— 对一个持续运行的矿井排水泵控制器,不终止本身是设计常态而非缺陷;无法据此独立判定作者源有问题,故判 uncertain 而不并入内生候选,以免与 #9/#13 重复注入同一条发现。

findings.refutation_reason: 核对链条全部对上：fcstm L65 逐字 `HighwayMode -> HighwayMode : if [R45RouteToken == 20];`；token 20 由 fcstm L33–L36 的 `-> [*] : /auto_finished_true effect { R45RouteToken = 20; }` 置位、由 L24 `[*] -> FinishState : if [R45RouteToken == 20]` 落地；作者 L45 逐字 `  HighwayMode --> FinishState : auto_finished=true`，而 FinishState 在作者源首次出现于 HighwayMode 块（L12–L26）内的 L21 `    cruise --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<2`，按 PlantUML 首次出现定作用域即落在 HighwayMode 内。故作者写的确是「复合态 → 自己的后代」，UML 下就是退出并重入。⚠️ 必须随判定带走的 caveat：pyfcstm 的触发条件按 transition_info.py:29 是 `from_path == to_path`，fcstm 那条自环是 token 派发编码（`R45RouteToken` 在 relabel/HOWTO.md §A.1 明列为投影合成物），作者源里**没有**逐字的 `HighwayMode --> HighwayMode`——判读者要去看的是 L45 与 L21 的作用域错放，不是去找一条自环。

findings.message: Leaf state 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0012.Terminate' has no outgoing transition.
findings.evidence: 作者源逐字：L11 `Off --> Terminate`，L12 `Terminate : final`。作者用「普通状态 + 描述行 final」冒充终止伪状态——PlantUML 的 `X : text` 只是给 X 加一行说明，不使其成为 final，投影因此忠实地保留为 `state Terminate named "Terminate\n[PlantUML body] final"`（fcstm L21），没有任何合成元素参与。祖先出边检查（陷阱 1）：Terminate 位于顶层，其父就是根状态机 `llms_emp_feedback_final_0012`，根没有、也不可能有出边（`grep "Terminate"` 全文只有 L11/L12 两处），故不存在外层成组迁移能让它离开。进入 Terminate 后系统真死锁，是作者源内生缺陷。
findings.refutation_reason: Verified, not refuted. (1) Cited lines exist verbatim: `grep -n Terminate stm0.puml` returns exactly two hits, L11 `Off --> Terminate` and L12 `Terminate : final` — so Terminate is an author element, not synthesized, and has zero outgoing edges in the author source itself. (2) PlantUML semantics check: `X : text` is a description line; the real final-state forms are `--> [*]` or `<<end>>`, neither used. The projector agreed and preserved it as a normal state, fcstm L21 `state Terminate named "Terminate\n[PlantUML body] final"` — it did not silently promote the description to a final pseudostate, which is the faithful reading. (3) Trap 1 (ancestor outgoing edge) independently re-checked by me, not taken on trust: Terminate is declared at top level, so its only ancestor is the root state `llms_emp_feedback_final_0012`; in model.fcstm nothing outside that root block exists except `def int R45RouteToken = 0;` (L1), and the root has no outgoing transition — a root cannot have one. So there is no outer group transition that could carry the machine out of Terminate. (4) codes.yaml L1882-1892: the code fires on 'a non-pseudo leaf state has no outgoing transition', which is exactly the author-source fact. Intrinsic. Caveat for downstream use: this is the SAME root cause as the two W_TOPOLOGICAL_NOEXIT entries below, not an independent third defect.

findings.message: Transition 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0012.Off' -> 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0012.Terminate' has no event or guard.
findings.evidence: 作者源逐字 L11 `Off --> Terminate`——全文唯一一条没有 `:` 触发标签的迁移（对比 L3 `Off --> Operate : start`、L6 `Idle --> AcceleratingOrCruising : accelerate`、L10 `Operate --> Off : keyOff` 都带事件），投影未添加任何东西（fcstm L25 `Off -> Terminate;`）。在本系统语境下这是缺陷而非无害 info：无触发的完成迁移使 Off 变成瞬态，一进 Off 就会落向 Terminate，从而使 NL 第 2 条要求的 `Off --> Operate : start`（L3）实际不可用。
findings.refutation_reason: Verified, not refuted — and I specifically applied the rule-4 test (is an I_ diagnostic being called a defect without a context argument?). It does have one, and the argument checks out. (1) Author L11 is `Off --> Terminate` with no `:` label; of the 8 arrow lines in stm0.puml, 5 carry `:` labels (L3 `start`, L6 `accelerate`, L7 `brake`, L8 `stop`, L10 `keyOff`) and the 3 unlabeled ones are `[*] --> Off`, `[*] --> Idle` and L11 — i.e. L11 is the only unlabeled NORMAL transition, the other two being initial-pseudostate edges. (Minor wording imprecision in the evidence's phrase '全文唯一一条', but the substance is right and matches the fact that inspect emitted this code exactly once.) (2) Projection added nothing: fcstm L25 is bare `Off -> Terminate;` while every genuine event transition in the same file carries `: /event` (L13-L15, L24) — and README §Event Scoping confirms `: /...` is the absolute-scope trigger form, so L25's lack of it is real triggerlessness, not an encoding artifact. (3) Context argument holds: root entry is `[*] -> Off` (fcstm L23, unconditional), and codes.yaml L3213-3215 calls this shape an 'unconditional fall-through candidate' (cf. W_TRANSITION_SHADOWED's example, where an unguarded outgoing edge preempts later ones), so at power-on with no event yet pending the machine slides Off -> Terminate and dies — directly defeating nl.txt item 1 ('Once the device is powered on, the system enters the `Operate` state') and item 2 ('can be turned on with the `start` signal'), both of which I read verbatim. I would soften the evidence's absolute claim that `start` is 'unusable' (with a queued `start` the earlier L24 transition could win, making it racy rather than dead), but the power-on death is unconditional, so this is a genuine, author-side defect in this system's context.

findings.evidence: 环为作者源自带、非投影引入：L3 `Off --> Operate : start`、L10 `Operate --> Off : keyOff` 构成外层环，L6/L7/L8（`accelerate` / `brake` / `stop`）构成子态环。但 NL 描述的就是 start/keyOff 反复开关的反应式控制器，非平凡 SCC 属应有形态，按 I_ 级判据不判缺陷。

findings.message: A root-reachable leaf or cycle has no guard-agnostic route to the root exit sink.
findings.evidence: 根因与上面的 deadlock 同源，且在作者源可逐字定位：全文 `grep -- "--> [*]"` 命中数为 0，作者从未写出真正的根终止伪状态；他只写了 L11 `Off --> Terminate` + L12 `Terminate : final`。也就是说作者「意图」有终止（写了 final 字样），但实现成普通状态，于是 Off↔Operate 这个环没有任何通往根 exit sink 的路径。若 L11 写成 `Off --> [*]`，本告警即消失——说明它由作者源的建模错误引起，不由合成元素引起（本 pair 无任何合成状态，仅有合成变量 R45RouteToken，而本检查 guard-agnostic）。
findings.refutation_reason: Verified, not refuted. (1) The load-bearing negative claim is machine-checkable and I re-ran it: `grep -c -- "--> \[\*\]" stm0.puml` = 0, and the only `[*]` occurrences are L2 `[*] --> Off` and L5 `[*] --> Idle` — both incoming. The author genuinely never wrote a root exit, so no root exit sink exists to reach. (2) Projection-induction ruled out on the check's own terms: codes.yaml L3325-3329 declares `verification_scope: topological_only`, i.e. guard-agnostic, so the synthetic `R45RouteToken` guards (the standard encoding of author L10's group transition `Operate --> Off : keyOff`) cannot create or destroy edges for this analysis. I also confirmed 0012's fcstm contains NO synthetic states at all (unlike 0032, which has three UnspecifiedInitial) — every state in the SCC (Off, Idle, AcceleratingOrCruising, Braking) is an author element. (3) The SCC itself is authorial: L3 `Off --> Operate : start` + L10 group exit close the outer loop, L6/L7/L8 close the inner Idle->AcceleratingOrCruising->Braking->Idle loop. (4) The counterfactual is correct: Off is a member of the SCC, so writing L11 as `Off --> [*]` would hand the SCC a route and clear the warning — which localizes the cause at the author's L11/L12, not at the projector. Qualification I record rather than refute: a reactive controller with no root exit is not per se pathological, so the *defect-ness* of this particular instance rests on the author's own expressed termination intent (`Terminate : final`); its *intrinsic-ness* is unconditional. It also shares one root cause with the W_DEADLOCK_LEAF entry and the deadlock-kind entry below.

findings.message: A root-reachable leaf or cycle has no guard-agnostic route to the root exit sink.
findings.evidence: 与本 pair 的 W_DEADLOCK_LEAF 为同一事实的另一视角：作者源 L11 `Off --> Terminate`、L12 `Terminate : final`，Terminate 无任何出边（全文仅这两处提及），位于顶层因而无外层成组迁移可救（陷阱 1 已核），且作者源无 `--> [*]` 根终止点，故它既非 exit sink 又无路到 exit sink。内生。
findings.refutation_reason: Verified, not refuted. This is the deadlock-kind projection of the same author-source facts, and I re-checked each independently rather than inheriting them from the W_DEADLOCK_LEAF entry: (a) `grep -n Terminate stm0.puml` yields only L11 and L12, so Terminate has no outgoing edge in the author source and appears nowhere else that could give it one; (b) fcstm confirms the same shape — L25 `Off -> Terminate;` is the sole reference to it besides its L21 declaration, so the projector added no outgoing edge and no synthetic escape; (c) trap-1 ancestor check redone: Terminate is top-level, its only ancestor is the root, and the root has no outgoing transition, so no outer group transition can release it; (d) `grep -c -- "--> [*]"` = 0 means Terminate is neither the exit sink nor able to reach one. Both halves of the code's condition therefore hold on author content alone. Intrinsic. Two qualifications: it is guard-agnostic (codes.yaml `topological_only`), so the synthetic R45RouteToken is irrelevant; and it is the SAME underlying authorial mistake as items 1 and 3 in this pair — downstream material must not treat the three as three separate ground-truth defects.

findings.message: The topology does not force all root-reachable executions to eventually reach the root terminator.

findings.message: Composite state 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0016' has no unconditional [*] entry transition.
findings.evidence: 作者源 line 2 逐字 `[*] --> SearchMission : Start Mission` —— 初始迁移带触发事件 `Start Mission`。UML 规定 initial pseudostate 的出迁移不得带 trigger（只允许 guard 与 effect），因此「顶层不存在任何无条件入口迁移」这一事实在作者源上直接成立，与投影无关：fcstm line 61 原样保留 `[*] -> SearchMission : /Start_Mission;`，未合成任何元素，诊断 refs 的 `existing_conditional_count=1` 正对应这一条。grep 全文顶层再无其它 `[*] -->`（line 5/8/13/18/19 的 `[*]` 均在 SearchMission 或各 Region 内部）。后果实在：机器在 Start Mission 事件到来前没有定义的起始配置。
findings.refutation_reason: 查了四件事。(a) 作者源 line 2 逐字为 `[*] --> SearchMission : Start Mission`，引用无误；grep 全文 `[*]` 得 line 2/5/8/13/18/19/26/33，顶层确实只有 line 2 这一条，其余全在 SearchMission、各 Region、FormationAdjust、AttackState 内部。(b) 重跑 inspect 拿到真实 refs：`composite_path=llms_emp_feedback_final_0016`、`existing_conditional_count=1`、`first_child_name=SearchMission`，与 evidence 所述完全一致。(c) 读 `analyzers/structural.py:_initial_unconditional_missing_warnings`，判据是「该复合态的 initial_targets 中无一条 is_unconditional」；我逐个核了其余复合态：SearchMission(line 45 无条件)、Region1(line 34 无条件)、Region2(line 24 有一条无条件)、Region3(line 16 无条件)、FormationAdjust(line 49)、AttackState(line 54) 全部有无条件初始，故只有 root 触发本诊断，报的确实是 line 2 那条。(d) 核合成元素：该诊断挂在合成的 root 包装态上，但它唯一的初始迁移就是作者 line 2（fcstm line 61 `[*] -> SearchMission : /Start_Mission;`，与 fcstm 里其它由 PlantUML trigger 转来的 `/Event` 写法一致，不是 effect）；0016 的 fcstm 里那堆 InvalidInitialtr_0005/0007、InvalidFinaltr_0008、R45RouteToken 都在 SearchMission 内部，与 root 初始无关。PlantUML 迁移标签语法 `event [guard] / action` 下未带 `/` 的 `Start Mission` 处在 trigger 位，投影读法是标准读法；UML 2.5.1 规定 initial pseudostate 出迁移不得带 trigger，故「顶层无无条件入口」在作者源逐字成立、投影未参与。

findings.message: State 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0017.Collision_Avoidance_Active_Mode.F' is unreachable from the root entry path.
findings.evidence: 作者源**整份文件没有顶层初始迁移**:全部三处 `[*] -->` 都在复合态内部(L4 `[*] --> F : collision detected`、L9、L14),L2 `state Collision_Avoidance_Active_Mode {` 到 L17 `}` 外只有 L1/L18 的 @startuml/@enduml。故没有任何路径进入该复合态,F 在作者源上同样不可达。中介说明:投影合成的 `UnspecifiedInitial` 成为根入口,把这个缺口具体化了;若投影改为直接进入复合态则 F 可达,故请人工复核该条的落点应记在"缺顶层初始"而非 F 本身。
findings.refutation_reason: ⭐ 推翻归属与主语，⛔ 不推翻「缺顶层初始」那条真缺陷。作者源确实没有顶层 `[*] -->`（我逐行看过 L1-L18，三处 `[*] -->` 全在 L4/L9/L14 的区内），这一点判定单没错。但「F 不可达」这个属性是**本仓库自己的** `plantuml_source_lowering.py` 造出来的：`prepare_missing_initial_helpers()` 在缺初始的 scope 里 reserve 一个合成态 `UnspecifiedInitial` 并把该 scope 的 `[*]` 指向它，源码注释写明这是 fail-closed（"enters a visible stoppable placeholder instead of guessing a child"）。核对 0017/model.fcstm：L4 声明 `UnspecifiedInitial`、L19 `[*] -> UnspecifiedInitial;`，而它**没有任何出边** —— 于是整个复合态连带 F/R/P 一律变不可达。机械判据：`grep -c` 占位符在 0007/0027/0037 上是 0、在 0017 上是 8，而 0017 的合成态恰好插在被报不可达的那个 scope 的上游。仓库内已有实测反事实（[wellformedness_attribution.md](project_1_llm_state_machine_modeling/paper_stm_issue_discover/discover_matrix/docs/protocol/rulings/wellformedness_attribution.md)、[ground_truth_limitations.md](project_1_llm_state_machine_modeling/paper_stm_issue_discover/discover_matrix/docs/protocol/ground_truth_limitations.md) §5）：删掉占位符行再跑，pyfcstm 报的是落在复合态上的 `E_INITIAL_TRANSITION_INVALID`，**不是子态不可达**。判定单自己也承认「若投影改为直接进入复合态则 F 可达」—— 承认了该属性在投影选择下会翻转。按内生登记会把一个作者缺陷放大成 3 条子态 + 2 条事件，且主语落在无辜的 F 上。正确落点：`<root>` 缺顶层初始，一条。

findings.evidence: 陷阱 2 已按要求核作者源初始边写法：作者源全文 `grep "\[\*\]"` 只有两处——L2 `[*] --> OffState` 与 L8 `[*] --> IdleRegion`，三个 region 内部一条初始边都没有。IdleRegion 逐字为 L9 `state IdleRegion {` / L10 `IdleState : Idle` / L11 `}`：既无 `[*] --> IdleState`，全文也没有任何迁移以 IdleState 为目标（`grep IdleState` 仅命中 L10 本身）。所以在作者源上 IdleState 就永不被激活，投影合成的 `UnspecifiedInitial` 只是把「作者未定义子态入口」这件事显式化，并未改变入口路径。反证：同 region 类中被作者直接点名的 CruisingState（L24 `AccelerateRegion --> CruisingState : Reach Speed`）就没有被报不可达，说明投影忠实保留了直接打靶的入口。该缺陷还直接违反 NL 第 1 条（系统应能处于 Idle）。
findings.refutation_reason: Verified, not refuted — this is the class I scrutinized hardest, because the fcstm does contain a synthesized `UnspecifiedInitial` (L12) and the warning could plausibly be blamed on it. It cannot be. (1) Cited lines are exact: L9 `state IdleRegion {` / L10 `IdleState : Idle` / L11 `}`, and `grep -n "\[\*\]" stm0.puml` returns exactly two hits, L2 `[*] --> OffState` and L8 `[*] --> IdleRegion` — zero initial edges inside any of the three inner regions, as claimed. (2) `grep -n IdleState stm0.puml` returns ONLY L10, its own declaration; the sole edge into IdleRegion from elsewhere is L27 `BrakeRegion --> IdleRegion : Stop`, which targets the composite, not the substate. So on the author source no defined path ever activates IdleState. (3) Synthesis-blame test: `grep -c Unspecified stm0.puml` = 0, i.e. UnspecifiedInitial is projector-added — but it is NOT the subject of the diagnostic, and the alternative (routing `[*]` to the sole declared substate) would mean inventing an initial edge the author never wrote, i.e. silently repairing the defect. The projector instead made the omission visible and even gave the placeholder the region's group-exit edges (fcstm L17-L19) so the machine still functions — the opposite of manufacturing a fault. (4) Positive control I confirmed myself: CruisingState, the only substate the author directly targets (L24 `AccelerateRegion --> CruisingState : Reach Speed`), received a real inbound in fcstm L25 and is absent from the unreachable list. Unreachability tracks author targeting. (5) It does violate nl.txt item 1 (Idle must be occupiable). Intrinsic.

findings.refutation_reason: Not refuted, but with a citation error recorded. (1) The primary cited block is exact: L13 `state AccelerateRegion {` / L14 `AcceleratingState : Accelerating` / L15 `CruisingState : Cruising` / L16 `}`, with no `[*] -->` inside. (2) `grep -n AcceleratingState stm0.puml` returns ONLY L14 — nothing anywhere targets it — which is the load-bearing fact and I verified it independently. (3) CITATION ERROR: the evidence calls L25 one of the edges 'entering this region', but L25 is `AccelerateRegion --> BrakeRegion : Brake`, an OUTGOING edge; my `grep -- "--> \(AccelerateRegion\|IdleRegion\|BrakeRegion\)"` shows the sole inbound edge to AccelerateRegion is L22 `IdleRegion --> AccelerateRegion : Accelerate`. I judged this non-load-bearing rather than fatal: the conclusion needs only 'no edge targets AcceleratingState', which grep settles without L25. Downstream material should drop L25 from this item's line citations. (4) The evidence's own control checks out verbatim: fcstm L25 is indeed `[*] -> CruisingState : if [R45RouteToken == 6]`, so the sibling the author DID target got an inbound and was not reported, while AcceleratingState — which additionally has outgoing edges (fcstm L28, L30, L33) but no inbound — is. That asymmetry inside one region is strong proof the warning follows author targeting, not the synthetic UnspecifiedInitial (which appears at fcstm L24 and is absent from stm0.puml, but is not the diagnostic's subject). Violates nl.txt item 1. Intrinsic.

findings.refutation_reason: Verified, not refuted, and this item's citations are clean (unlike the AcceleratingState one). (1) Cited lines exact: L18 `state BrakeRegion {` / L19 `BrakingState : Braking` / L20 `}`, no `[*] -->` inside (the file's only two `[*]` hits are L2 and L8). (2) `grep -n BrakingState stm0.puml` returns ONLY L19. (3) All three cited inbound edges exist and all three target the composite, exactly as claimed — my grep confirms L23 `IdleRegion --> BrakeRegion : Brake`, L25 `AccelerateRegion --> BrakeRegion : Brake`, L26 `CruisingState --> BrakeRegion : Brake`; none names BrakingState. So the author wrote three ways INTO the region and no way into its only substate. (4) The projected region (fcstm L38-L46) shows the same asymmetry as the other two: BrakingState has outgoing group-exit edges (L42, L43) but zero inbound, while entry lands on the visible placeholder (L41). The placeholder is projector-added but is not the diagnostic's subject, and replacing it with `[*] -> BrakingState` would be inventing an author-absent initial edge — i.e. concealing the defect, not preserving fidelity. Violates nl.txt items 1 and 3. Intrinsic.

findings.message: Leaf state 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0036.InitialState' has no outgoing transition.
findings.evidence: 作者源 line 2 逐字 `[*] --> InitialState`、line 3 逐字 `InitialState : Initial State`；grep 全文**无任何** `InitialState -->`。陷阱 1 已查：InitialState 直接位于图顶层（region0），**无祖先复合态**，故不存在外层成组出边可救；fcstm 侧一致（line 20-21，root 除 `[*] ->` 外零出边）。「叶态无出边」这一事实在作者源逐字成立，且不涉任何合成元素与拍平改写。⚠️ 限定：若严格按作者的 `--` 并发读法，region0 单独终止在 UML 下合法（另两区继续运行），此时它表现为「作者把顺序阶段误写成并发区」这个另一个内生缺陷。两种读法都指向作者源的真实缺口（机器起始态无法离开，或并发区误用），故判 intrinsic。
findings.refutation_reason: 查了三件事。(a) 作者源 line 2 `[*] --> InitialState`、line 3 `InitialState : Initial State` 逐字无误；`grep -n 'InitialState *-'` **零命中**，确认无任何出边。(b) 祖先出边：InitialState 位于图顶层，作者源无祖先复合态可提供成组出边；fcstm 侧其 parent 是合成 root，root 除 line 21 `[*] -> InitialState;` 外零出边（重跑 inspect 的 refs 也给出 `parent_path=llms_emp_feedback_final_0036`）。故祖先型假阳性不成立。(c) 核合成元素：fcstm line 20 的 InitialState 是作者真实名。(d) 投影确实做了并发拍平（fcstm line 1 的 named 串记录了 region 0/1/2 与两处 `--` 分隔符），且拍平**另外**产生了 4 条 W_UNREACHABLE_STATE（Region1/Region2 的内容），但那 4 条不在本清单内；拍平并未删除或改写 InitialState 的出边——它在作者源就一条也没有。至于 evidence 里那条限定（若按并发读法则 region0 单独停驻在 UML 下合法、此时表现为把顺序阶段误写成并发区）：我核了 nl.txt，NL 要求「Before the mission is completed, the UAV swarm continuously performs target search tasks」，而该模型的起始态无法走到 TargetSearch，两种读法下都是作者源的真实缺口。判定成立。

findings.refutation_reason: 复核通过。(1) 行号与引文：stm0.puml:7 逐字 `[*] --> AutoInitial : Enter Autonomous Mode`，准确。(2) 块边界复核：stm0.puml:6 逐字 `state Autonomous {`，stm0.puml:10 逐字 `}`——所引边界正确；块内（第 7-9 行）只有第 7 行含 `[*]`，无第二条裸初始边，与 refs `existing_conditional_count: 1` 一致。(3) 实跑复现：确有第二条 `W_INITIAL_UNCONDITIONAL_MISSING`，`composite_path: llms_emp_feedback_final_0040.Autonomous`，`first_child_name: AutoInitial`，主体正确。(4) 合成元素排查：Autonomous（第 6 行）、AutoInitial（第 7/8 行）均在作者源存在，非投影合成；fcstm:12 `[*] -> AutoInitial : /Enter_Autonomous_Mode;` 是对第 7 行的忠实搬运，标签不是投影添加的。(5) 对照强化：同一 pair 内如果投影会给初始边乱加事件，0030 的内层 `[*] -> Navigating` 也该被报，但它没有——说明本条的标签来自作者。(6) message 里「`Enter Autonomous Mode` 只是重述进入本态、并非系统事件」属判定方的语义解读；我核对 nl.txt 后确认该短语不在需求所列的任何事件中（需求只给 power on / front_distance>10 / human steering cmd / brake pressed / in(auto final) / power off），故该解读有据。即便剥掉这层解读，诊断的事实基础（初始边带触发）仍在作者源逐字成立。

findings.message: Composite state 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0042' has no unconditional [*] entry transition.
findings.evidence: 作者源逐字 L2 `[*] --> Off : keyOff`——作者给初始迁移挂了事件触发 `keyOff`。投影忠实保留为 fcstm L24 `[*] -> Off : /keyOff;`，未添加任何元素，根复合态因此确实没有无条件入口。这是内生缺陷而非无害写法：UML 的 initial transition 不允许带触发事件（只允许 guard/effect），且带触发意味着系统上电后要等一个 `keyOff` 才进入首状态，与 NL 第 1 条「Once the device is powered on, the system enters the `Operate` state」及第 2 条（keyOff 是关机信号）直接矛盾——把关机事件当成了开机入口条件。
findings.refutation_reason: Verified, not refuted — and the one point where I suspected an artifact turned out to confirm the judgment. My initial worry was that fcstm L24 `[*] -> Off : /keyOff;` might be an EFFECT (slash notation), in which case the transition would be unconditional and the diagnostic would be an encoding artifact. pyfcstm/README.md §Event Scoping settles it: `: /...` is the ABSOLUTE-scope event trigger form ('Absolute Event (`: /...`)'), while effects use the separate `effect { }` clause (as on fcstm L12-L14, L23). So `/keyOff` is a genuine trigger, faithfully carrying author L2 `[*] --> Off : keyOff` — which I confirmed is the only `[*]`-line at root (the other, L7 `[*] --> Idle`, is inside Operate and unlabeled). (2) codes.yaml L1934-1941 defines the code as firing when 'guarded or event-triggered entry transitions' leave no guaranteed initial child — i.e. the diagnostic is about the author's trigger, matching `existing_conditional_count = 1`. (3) Projection-induction ruled out by control: in the sibling pairs the projector emitted `[*] -> Off;` (0012 fcstm L23) and `[*] -> OffState;` (0032 fcstm L60), both unconditional, mirroring their unlabeled author `[*] -->` lines. It does not add triggers to initial edges; 0042 differs only because the author labeled his. (4) Defect-ness argument holds: nl.txt item 1 reads verbatim 'Once the device is powered on, the system enters the `Operate` state' and item 2 assigns `keyOff` the shutdown role, so gating power-on entry on the shutdown event is contradictory. (Sharpening the evidence: `[*] --> Off` also targets Off rather than Operate, which is a separate deviation from item 1; the trigger is the part this code reports.) Intrinsic.

findings.refutation_reason: 查了四件事，含 I_ 级专查的语境要求。(a) 作者源 line 7 逐字 `Area1 --> Area2`，无事件无守卫，引用无误；fcstm line 16 原样保留。(b) 读 `analyzers/transition_info.py:_eventless_guardless_transition_infos` 确认判据就是 `event is None and guard is None`；重跑 inspect 的 refs `transition_span` 指向 fcstm line 16 col 9-24，正对应作者 line 7，未串行到别处。(c) 核合成元素：Area1/Area2 是作者 line 6-9 的真实名（fcstm line 10-11）；投影确实把两个并发区拍平进 SearchState 的单区（fcstm line 9 的 named 串记录了 region 0/1 与 line 10 的 `--` 分隔符），但拍平不改变这三条迁移无触发这一逐字事实，也不改变环的存在。(d) I_ 级语境：本组的判定不是拿「非平凡 SCC / 不终止」当缺陷 —— inspect 另报的 I_NONTRIVIAL_SCC 与 I_TOPOLOGICAL_NON_TERMINATING 覆盖了 SearchState↔FormationAdjustment↔AttackState 这个反应式回路，那两条本属正常且不在清单内。清单里这三条报的是另一件事：line 7/8/9 首尾相接成环且全部无触发无守卫，即三条完成迁移成环，UML run-to-completion 下进入 Area1 即立刻完成并迁出、循环不产生稳定配置，机器无法静默去接收 `Intercepted` / `Task Assignment Received`，属零时间发散。语境论证到位且技术上成立。旁证：同一 NL（本组 6 个 pair 的 nl.txt 哈希相同）下 0016 把同样的三区搜索建成了 `Finished Region1/2/3 Search` 事件驱动，说明「区域轮转应事件驱动」不是凭空要求；同一份 0056 的另一并发区 line 12/13 也写了正规事件触发，作者并非不会写。
